g.title: cluster_pipe

g.title: THRESH
g.text: THREE SIGNALS, THREE THRESHOLDS, TWO SOURCES
AG antigen availability K = 0.01 units (10⁴ amastigotes) from the TOTAL burden
AGH IL-10 switch K = 60 units (6×10⁷) from the VISCERA only
AGS systemic illness K = 300 units (3×10⁸) from the VISCERA only
KAG ≪ K50_IL10 is the claim: antigen is still abundant over a burden range in
which IL-10 has already switched off. Getting the patient into that ~3.8-log
window and holding them there is the whole job of a drug course.

g.title: TMEM
g.text: built at KTP, decays t½ ≈ 192 d, cap 2.0

g.title: SEPARAT
g.text: burden the host can still finish alone.

g.title: RACE
g.text: THE RACE: TMEM builds at KTP·antigen; IL-10 rises only above
burden K50 = 60 units. Whichever crosses first decides subclinical
infection versus clinical kala-azar — with no change to the parasite.

g.title: IL10
g.text: produced only at HIGH burden, and only

g.text: This is why PKDL seeds transmission

g.text: efficient in liver, FAILS in spleen

g.title: AMBKID
g.text: driven by FREE plasma drug only

g.title: AUCSPLIT
g.text: THE SPLIT: one mg/kg of amphotericin makes TWO integrals
Encapsulation multiplies the first and divides the second.

g.title: AKILL
g.text: Hill 2 — the FASTEST of the four

g.title: TIMESYN
g.text: SYNERGY IN TIME, NOT IN CONCENTRATION: L-AmB drops the burden
in days; the miltefosine tail (t½ 7 d) holds it down through the
weeks the memory pool needs to build. Neither drug does both.

g.title: KWAST

g.text: sudden death at high cumulative Sb

g.text: a physiological state, not a genotype:
seen by the macrophage at 0.15 × KIMM

g.text: (VL is a classic secondary HLH trigger)

g.text: driven by Hb, albumin, WBC, burden

g.title: SEROTRAP
g.text: SEROLOGY TRAP: IgG t½ ≈ 96 d, so
rK39 stays positive for years after
cure while burden has fallen > 5 logs.
A MODEL OUTPUT, not an assumption.
